answer: Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the harbor queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 989 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the crystal. The quartz index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 29 pays that 172 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
